title: Damage Dummys
description: Adds Damage Dummys for each tier of armor that display how much damage was delt to them
body:
DamageDummy's is a lightweight utility mod that adds training dummies for combat testing. Monitor your damage in real time as each hit is displayed above the dummy. Whether you're balancing custom weapons, comparing enchantments, or optimizing your loadout, DamageDummy's provides an easy way to measure your strength without harming real mobs.

DamageDummy's adds training dummies with useful combat-testing features:

🪵 Placeable training dummies
⚔️ Displays damage dealt
❤️ Automatically heals after each hit
🛡️ Supports armor and enchantment testing
🔧 Perfect for mod developers and survival players alike
